article.title: IPO today: BLS Polymers and SFC Environmental open; Jio listing next
article.dek: BLS Polymers, SFC Environmental and Wiscon Industries begin bidding; EAAA remains open, while Jio and Paras Healthcare approach listing.
body: Namaste investors, welcome to today's IPO class. BLS Polymers and SFC Environmental Technologies opened for bidding on Tuesday, while EAAA India Alternatives remains open. Wiscon Industries also began its SME issue; Core4 Engineers reached its final bidding day. Check the NSE and BSE issue pages for final exchange-level bid figures.

BLS Polymers | The ₹255 crore issue is entirely a fresh sale of shares. The price band is ₹142–150, with a lot size of 100 shares. The issue is open from October 27 to October 29. Fresh proceeds are intended for manufacturing expansion, working capital and other company purposes.

SFC Environmental Technologies | The wastewater-treatment company's approximately ₹668 crore issue is priced at ₹313–330. It includes ₹150 crore of fresh capital and an offer for sale by existing holders. Bidding is scheduled through October 29.

EAAA India Alternatives | The ₹1,200 crore offer is an offer for sale, with a price band of ₹1,585–1,665 and a closing date of October 28. An OFS transfers shares from selling shareholders; it does not raise new cash for the issuer.

Jio Platforms allotment and listing watch | HDFC Sky's final October 23 tally reported 22.19 times overall subscription, with QIB at 70.55 times, NII at 14.00 times and retail at 2.72 times. Allotment was scheduled for October 26, and trading is expected to begin October 28. Applicants should confirm their individual result on the registrar's official portal.

Paras Healthcare | Allotment was scheduled for October 26, with listing expected October 28. The registrar is MUFG Intime India. Individual allotment is not verified by news reports; check the registrar rather than assuming a successful allocation.

Coming up | MK Sons Fine Jewels is scheduled to open October 28; Bombay Coated and Special Steels is scheduled for October 29. The SME calendar also includes Carver Roboweld and Ajwa Projects. Final schedules and lot requirements must be confirmed against offer documents.

Today's concept: fresh issue versus OFS. BLS Polymers is a fresh issue, so proceeds go to the company. EAAA India Alternatives is an OFS, so sale proceeds go to the selling shareholders. Subscription demand is not a prediction of the listing price.

Source and timing note: this calendar uses the Upstox report updated October 26; Jio's final category subscription is from HDFC Sky for October 23. A complete exchange-verified October 27 closing subscription breakdown for the newly opened IPOs was not available from the official pages inspected at publication, so no unverified QIB, NII or retail figures are presented as final. GMP is unofficial, unregulated and excluded from the charts.
Key takeaway: IPOs differ in use of proceeds, bidding windows and lot sizes. Verify the latest red herring prospectus and exchange notices. This is education, not a recommendation.
article.indiaImpact: A busy Indian primary-market week spans alternative investment management, polymer manufacturing, wastewater technology and SME offers. Applicants need to distinguish issue dates from allotment and listing dates.
